purpose: Define the Expose monitor for published Projects, Broker matches, ranking evidence and assignment state as a provenance-backed projection with mutations routed through explicit canonical operations.

topics.name: FreeMarket Monitor
topics.purpose: Define the Expose monitor for published Projects, Broker matches, ranking evidence and assignment state as a provenance-backed projection with mutations routed through explicit canonical operations.

semantics.trace_rule: Displayed match/ranking items retain Project, identity, evidence and policy refs.
semantics.action_rule: Publish/unpublish/assign/accept controls invoke separate explicit canonical operations.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing or ranking a candidate does not grant assignment authority.
semantics.merit_rule: Monitor cannot directly modify MeritCore points/Tier/trust.
semantics.layout_rule: Visual ordering/grouping does not create market or Project semantics.

invariants.rule: FreeMarket/Broker matching and ranking operate over explicit Project, identity, PortfolioCore and MeritCore semantics without creating duplicate work, identity or merit authority.

hard_gates.condition: monitor directly assigns candidate without explicit operation
UI order becomes semantic ranking without policy
